findings.explanation: display_name is a literal ("training-dataset") instead of a variable. Sibling modules in this fleet (terraform-gcp-dataproc, terraform-gcp-datafusion, terraform-gcp-composer, terraform-gcp-documentai) all expose their primary resource's name/display_name as var.name / var.display_name; this module is the outlier. A caller cannot instantiate this module more than once per project without a naming collision, and cannot give the dataset a meaningful name.
findings.fix:
variable "dataset_display_name" {
  type        = string
  description = "Display name for the Vertex AI dataset"
  default     = "training-dataset"
}

# in google_vertex_ai_dataset.main.tf
display_name = var.dataset_display_name
findings.remediation: Add variable "dataset_display_name" (default = "training-dataset" to preserve current behavior) and reference it as display_name.
findings.title: Dataset display_name is hardcoded, blocking reuse of the module twice in one project

findings.explanation: Both name and display_name are the literal "model-endpoint". `name` is a settable, project+region-unique field on this resource, so a second instantiation of this module in the same project/region fails outright rather than just producing a confusing display name.
findings.fix:
variable "endpoint_name" {
  type        = string
  description = "Name and display name for the Vertex AI endpoint"
  default     = "model-endpoint"
}

# in google_vertex_ai_endpoint.main.tf
name         = var.endpoint_name
display_name = var.endpoint_name
findings.remediation: Add variable "endpoint_name" (default = "model-endpoint") and use it for both name and display_name.
findings.title: Endpoint name/display_name are hardcoded

findings.explanation: name is the literal "featurestore". Featurestore names must be unique per project/region, so a second module instance in the same project/region will fail to apply.
findings.fix:
variable "featurestore_name" {
  type        = string
  description = "Name for the Vertex AI featurestore"
  default     = "featurestore"
}

# in google_vertex_ai_featurestore.main.tf
name = var.featurestore_name
findings.title: Featurestore name is hardcoded
